messages:
Vik: Quick sync: we need a compact set of landing copy permutations for Hosted / Dedicated / Private that we can spin up during the launch week. Aim: single test plan, easy tagging, clear lead routing.
Noelle: Agree. Proposal: 1 hero + 2 micro-variations per mode (trust vs velocity), shared benchmark strip under hero, form that captures deployment intent.
Jorge: For CTAs let's use consistent verb patterns: Hosted = "Try the API" (self-serve), Dedicated = "Reserve capacity" (calendar optional), Private = "Request private demo" (AE route). Keeps copy short.
Priya: Suggest the benchmark strip copy be ultra-brief: two-line intro + 3 metrics. Example: "Real customers, real workloads." Bullets: 
- Median latency: ~50ms (typical small models)
- Cost: up to 40% lower with batching & cache
- Typical throughput: hundreds to thousands of tokens/sec
We can add a "details" link to a full benchmark page.
Ken: Important: capture `deployment_interest` + `company_size` on form. Add a hidden `campaign_id` from UTM when traffic comes from launch posts. HubSpot field mapping please.
Vik: Routing logic: Hosted -> marketing list (auto nurture), Dedicated -> AE queue (tag:reserved_demo), Private -> Enterprise ops (tag:compliance_review). Let's keep dedicated optional calendar link so it doesn't block users.
Noelle: Microcopy variants:
Variant A (velocity): "Low latency. High throughput. One API."
Variant B (assurance): "Predictable SLAs, predictable cost. Run where you need."
Include short subheads for each.
Jorge: A/B test plan: run headline variants across Homepage slot + dedicated landing for 10 days, track conversion, demo requests, and lead quality (MQL -> SQL). Split 60/40 initial to gather signal faster.
Priya: Webinar tie-in: 30-min timed drop: "Launch webinar: Serving LLMs at scale \u2014 pick your deployment" 3 bullets: benchmarks & real case study, routing & fallback strategies, cost controls & quantization playbook. CTA: Register / Add to calendar. Also include a short qualifying question: "Are you evaluating Hosted, Dedicated, or Private?"
Ken: Implementation note: add `utm_deployment` param to outbound links from social posts and partner posts. Also tag leads from the webinar with `webinar_1799` to stitch later.
Vik: For launch posts: craft three intros: one for engineers (benchmarks & latency), one for platform leads (cost & rollout), one for security/compliance (private deploy features). Keep them one-liners + link to the corresponding landing page.
Noelle: Language guidance: avoid ops-level nouns like "KV cache". Use phrases like "smart caching" and "request batching" when needed. Keep CTAs action-oriented.
Jorge: Prequal microcopy on form: "What deployment are you most interested in?" helps route and improves lead scoring. Make it optional on Hosted flows.
Priya: I'll draft the webinar blurb + three landing headlines and drop in the shared doc by 3pm.
Ken: I'll update the form schema and HubSpot mapping by EOD. Adding hidden field `campaign_phase=launch_v1`.
Vik: We also want a tiny benchmark callout for social cards: one metric + a short tagline. E.g., "30% latency reduction in retail search (Dedicated)". Keep claims conservative and include a footnote on the landing.
Noelle: Ownership: Priya = landing copy + webinar blurb, Jorge = A/B experiment setup & analytics, Ken = form + hubspot, Vik = launch post drafts. Check-in tomorrow 10am.
ops-bot: note: assets-deck-v3 uploaded to /assets/launch/1799 (link)
Vik: Great. If anything slips, flag here. Thanks team :rocket:
